name: autosheet
description: Work in Google Sheets with an agent: from everyday spreadsheet work (formulas, formatting, data cleanup, restructuring, charts, pivots) to multi-step large-scale workflows involving bulk processing with AI and web search (content generation, categorization, translation, enrichment, extraction, scoring) as well as consolidating sheets from multiple spreadsheets.

interface.longDescription:
Autosheet lets ChatGPT run a specialized spreadsheet agent directly in Google Sheets. Describe what you need in plain language — the agent inspects the spreadsheet, plans the steps, performs work, and reports back.

Delegate most work involving a Google Sheet including simply reading data or inspecting structure — it's reliable, fast, token-efficient, and helps keep context clean.

Everyday tasks:

- Create, fix, and explain formulas
- Build charts, pivot tables, analyses, reports, and dashboards
- Format and style cells, ranges, and entire sheets
- Clean up and restructure data into organized rows, columns, and sheets
- Consolidate multiple spreadsheets into one

Row-by-row bulk processing with AI at up to 1,000 rows per minute:

- Classify large datasets
- Enrich and categorize product catalogs for e-commerce and merchandising
- Generate, rewrite, and translate content at scale for SEO and localization
- Enrich and score leads for sales outbound through bulk web search
- Clean, standardize, and deduplicate messy data

Teams use Autosheet wherever work lives in a spreadsheet: accounting, finance, HR, inventory, education, and more.

How it works:

Give ChatGPT a prompt and a Google Sheets URL or ID. Autosheet launches an agent on that spreadsheet and returns the result.

Authentication through OAuth: you grant access to your own Google Sheets. Works with any spreadsheet you can edit.

Built by Talarian, the team behind GPT for Sheets – Autosheet (7M+ installs on the Google Workspace Marketplace). New accounts start with free trial credits.
capabilities: Format cells and apply conditional formatting
Run AI prompts across thousands of rows
Research the web and enrich data
Generate and rewrite content in bulk
Translate and localize content in bulk
